bio.text: Andy Ellis is the Maryland Green Party's nominee for Governor in 2026, chosen in the party's online nominating primary held July 8 to 22, 2026, with Owen Silverman Andrews as his running mate for Lieutenant Governor.
According to his campaign, Ellis is a Baltimore resident and a former member of the Baltimore City Charter Review Commission.
In 2024 he chaired Baltimore for Democracy, a ballot issue committee formed to oppose a charter amendment on Baltimore City Council size (Question H), which voters defeated.

sources.title: Ellis, Andrews win Maryland Green Party nominations for Governor, Lieutenant Governor
